page.overview:
Who is Fire Nation airship captain?

When Toph, Sokka, and Suki infiltrated his airship during Sozin's Comet, the airship captain attempted to fight back against the intruders. He attacked Toph with comet-enchanced firebending, but she was able to deflect these attacks by wrapping a metal door around herself using metalbending. The captain was rendered immobile after Toph used metalbending to slam him onto the roof.
